properties.name: --ae-anchor-origin-x
properties.description:
Self pivot on the x axis.

Runtime output; read it in selectors/styles instead of using it as an activation command.

Value syntax: <percentage>.

properties.name: --ae-anchor-origin-y
properties.description:

Value syntax: <percentage>.

properties.name: --ae-anchor-switch-duration
properties.description:
Target-switch duration on one scheduled timeline. Scroll and layout update the destination without restarting; reduced motion disables switching.

Value syntax: <time>.

Default behavior: "0ms".

Suggested values: `0ms`, `150ms`, `250ms`. This is an open grammar, not a closed enumeration.

properties.name: --ae-anchor-switch-ease
properties.description:
CSS easing for Anchor's dynamic target geometry; position, pivots and matching dimensions share one uninterrupted clock, including without Web Animations.

Value syntax: <easing-function>.

Default behavior: "ease-in-out".

Suggested values: `linear`, `ease`, `ease-in-out`, `cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1)`, `steps(4,end)`. This is an open grammar, not a closed enumeration.

properties.description:

properties.name: --ae-present-dismiss-threshold
properties.description:
